channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, UK, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Shape Arts: Emergent Residency 2026/27 (Tate St Ives / Porthmeor Studios)
item.description: Shape Arts, with Tate St Ives · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · GBP 3,000 bursary for the selected residency artist (restricted to artists living or working in Cornwall, Devon or Somerset). Disabled artists in the rest of the UK can join the shortlisted cohort, which brings mentoring and profile but no stated bursary. No application fee.

item.title: Alpaca Festival 2027: Open Call for Pattern-Based Performances, Workshops and Talks (Sheffield, UK)
item.description: Pattern Club (Alpaca Festival) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Performances: artist fee plus national travel expenses. Workshops: artist fee, materials expenses and national travel expenses. Fee amounts are not yet confirmed (tight budget); additional costs may be covered on request. International travel is not covered beyond a small European train budget. Conference talks: no fee or expenses, in-person speakers get a free festival weekend pass and lunch on 6 and 7 May. No application fee.

item.title: BRAID Creative Commissions 2027: A Promise in Return (Responsible AI, GBP 8,000-12,000, Edinburgh Art Festival)
item.description: BRAID (Bridging Responsible AI Divides), University of Edinburgh, with Inspace, the Institute for Design Informatics and the Edinburgh Futures Institute · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Around seven commissions with budgets of GBP 8,000 to 12,000 each, inclusive of VAT and all costs. No application fee.

item.title: Arts Council England: National Lottery Project Grants (rolling)
item.description: Arts Council England · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 1,000 to GBP 100,000 per project. Decisions in about 8 weeks for requests up to GBP 30,000, about 12 weeks above that. No application fee.

item.title: Creative Scotland: Open Fund for Individuals (rolling)
item.description: Creative Scotland · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 500 to GBP 50,000 (two levels: up to GBP 20,000 with decisions in 10 weeks, GBP 20,001 to 50,000 in 14 weeks). National Lottery funded. No application fee.

item.title: The Elephant Trust: Autumn 2026 Grant Round (UK)
item.description: The Elephant Trust · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · Grants to visual artists of up to GBP 5,000; typical awards range GBP 2,000 to GBP 5,000. Projects with a total budget exceeding GBP 30,000 are not supported. No application fee.

item.title: Fluxus-CPGA Prize at Frieze London 2026
item.description: Fluxus Art Projects, with the Comite Professionnel des Galeries d'Art and Frieze London · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · GBP 15,000 prize, shared between the artist and their gallery. Participation is free of charge.

item.title: Delfina Foundation x Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation: Open Call for Artists from Portugal and Portuguese-Speaking African Nations (London residency)
item.description: Delfina Foundation, in partnership with the Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation (UK Branch) · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Twelve-week fully funded residency: a return economy-class flight, airport transfers in the UK, reimbursement of visa fees if required, a living allowance of GBP 40 per day, a materials budget of GBP 1,200, a travel pass for London's public transport network, and a single bedroom with a desk at Delfina Foundation, a house hosting up to eight residents with shared bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchen, library and dining room. No application fee.

item.title: The Photographers' Gallery: Future of Archives, Whose Archive is it Anyway? (Call for Speakers)
item.description: The Photographers' Gallery · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · GBP 200 speaker fee for each selected speaker. No application fee.

item.title: Open City Documentary Festival 2027 (Call for Entries)
item.description: Open City Documentary Festival / UCL · deadline 27 Nov 2026 · Screening fees for all selected works: GBP 275 for works over 60 min, GBP 140 for works over 40 min, GBP 70 for works under 40 min, GBP 100 for cross-platform projects (all incl. VAT)

item.title: GMAC Film: Little Pictures 2026/27 (Scotland)
item.description: GMAC Film (Glasgow Media Access Centre) · deadline 09 Sep 2026 · Up to GBP 6,000 production funding per film, plus training, workshops, industry mentorship and free equipment and resource access

item.title: Scottish Documentary Institute: Bridging the Gap 2026/27
item.description: Scottish Documentary Institute, with Screen Scotland and Northern Ireland Screen · deadline 09 Sep 2026 · Up to 4 films receive a full commission with a cash production budget (GBP 8,500 per film in the previous round) plus production and distribution support

item.title: 5 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Youth Music: Trailblazer Fund (Round 13)
    https://www.youthmusic.org.uk/funding/i-need-funding/trailblazer-fund
    Youth Music · deadline 28 Aug 2026 · GBP 2,000 to GBP 30,000 for organisations in England. No application fee.
  • ITER 2026: International Touring and Environmental Responsibility Programme
    https://juliesbicycle.org/news/iter-2026/
    Julie's Bicycle and in futurum, funded by Arts Council England, Arts Council Norway, Creative Scotland and the Danish Arts Foundation · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · The seminar programme is free to join. Groups of three or more participants can then apply for up to GBP 30,000 for collaborative projects, with funding applications open 6 November 2026 to 11 January 2027 and projects starting spring 2027. No application fee.
  • Arts Council England: Music Growth Fund, GBP 1,000-40,000 strand
    https://www.artscouncil.org.uk/music-growth-package/music-growth-fund-general-guidance
    Arts Council England · deadline 03 Sep 2026 · GBP 1,000 to GBP 40,000, from a total annual budget of GBP 3,000,000 for this strand in 2026/27. You must find at least 25 percent of the total project budget as CASH match funding. No application fee.
  • Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    https://waag.org/en/article/open-call-creative-interventions-trust-me-im-airtist/
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No application fee.
  • British Council Travel Grant Fund (film and XR, rolling)
    https://film.britishcouncil.org/opportunities/travel-grants-fund
    British Council, supported by BFI National Lottery funding in partnership with BFI NETWORK and the BFI International Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Varies by strand: short and feature film festival grants GBP 150 to 1,500 (typically up to GBP 750); XR travel-only grants GBP 150 to 1,500; large XR grants GBP 1,500 to 5,000; lab grants capped at GBP 6,000; co-production forum grants capped at GBP 2,000. Free to apply.

item.title: 2 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• University of East Anglia: Deputy Dean, CUCN-UEA Digital Creativity Institute
    https://vacancies.uea.ac.uk/vacancies/vacancy-search-results.aspx
    University of East Anglia (UEA), Faculty of Arts and Humanities · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · GBP 69,488 to 73,709 per annum depending on qualifications and experience, plus the standard UEA pension and leave package. No application fee.
  • UAL AKO Storytelling Institute: Storytelling Research Fellows 2026 (six posts)
    https://jobs.arts.ac.uk/job/12629-storytelling-research-fellows/
    University of the Arts London (UAL AKO Storytelling Institute), with the Power of Pop Fund · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · GBP 48,563 per annum pro rata (around GBP 19,425 for the part-time fellowship hours), plus UAL benefits. No application fee.

item.title: 5 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• BFI National Lottery Creative Challenge Fund (Round Two)
    https://www.bfi.org.uk/get-funding-support/create-films-tv-or-new-formats-storytelling/bfi-national-lottery-creative-challenge-fund
    British Film Institute (BFI National Lottery) · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · Award amounts are not published on the fund page. No application fee.
  • BFI National Lottery Impact Feature Funding (Higher-Budget Features)
    https://www.bfi.org.uk/get-funding-support/create-films-tv-or-new-formats-storytelling/bfi-filmmaking-fund-discovery-impact-feature-funding
    British Film Institute (BFI Filmmaking Fund, National Lottery) · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to GBP 1,250,000, the largest single award in the current BFI portfolio, though the BFI notes it does not expect to support many projects at the maximum level. Production budgets from GBP 1M to GBP 15M for experienced directors, GBP 3.5M to GBP 15M for debut directors. No application fee.
  • BFI National Lottery Development Funding (Feature Script and Package Development)
    https://www.bfi.org.uk/get-funding-support/create-films-tv-or-new-formats-storytelling/development-funding
    British Film Institute (BFI Filmmaking Fund, National Lottery) · deadline Rolling / undated · Award amounts are not published on the fund page. No application fee.
  • BFI National Lottery Audience Projects Fund
    https://www.bfi.org.uk/get-funding-support/bring-film-wider-audience/bfi-national-lottery-audience-projects-fund
    British Film Institute (BFI National Lottery) · deadline Rolling / undated · Pilot projects GBP 10,000 to GBP 20,000. Standard projects GBP 20,000 to GBP 500,000 per year. Immersive projects may include up to GBP 150,000 of production costs within the GBP 500,000 cap. Total fund GBP 19.7M over three years. No application fee.
  • BFI National Lottery Screen Heritage Fund: Individual Skills Funding
    https://www.bfi.org.uk/get-funding-support/bfi-national-lottery-screen-heritage-fund-project-resilience-skills-funding
    British Film Institute (BFI National Lottery Screen Heritage Fund) · deadline Rolling / undated · Award amounts are not published on the fund page. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
• BFI National Lottery Discovery Feature Funding (Debut Fiction Features)
    https://www.bfi.org.uk/get-funding-support/create-films-tv-or-new-formats-storytelling/bfi-filmmaking-fund-discovery-impact-feature-funding
    British Film Institute (BFI Filmmaking Fund, National Lottery) · deadline 13 Aug 2026 · Up to GBP 1,000,000 of National Lottery funding towards a fiction feature with a production budget between GBP 1,000,000 and GBP 3,500,000. No application fee.

item.title: 4 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 13 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Modern Art Oxford: Collaborative Micro-commissions Open Call 2026
    https://modernartoxford.org.uk/blog/open-call-2026
    Modern Art Oxford · deadline 26 Jul 2026 · GBP 1,000 artist fee per selected collective, plus up to GBP 500 production budget, curatorial mentorship from the Modern Art Oxford team, four months of public exhibition display, professional installation photography, promotion, technical and production support, artwork transport support within the South East, peer networking, and inclusion in a public preview event. No application fee.
  • CRASSH 25th Anniversary Exhibition: Knowledge in a Fractured World
    https://arbart.crassh.cam.ac.uk/call-for-art-knowledge-in-a-fractured-world/
    CRASSH, University of Cambridge · deadline 31 Jul 2026 · Exhibition from 5 October to 11 December 2026; no commission taken on sales. Free to enter.
  • Sarabande Foundation: Studio Residency 2026/27 (UK-based only)
    https://sarabandefoundation.org/en-us/pages/studio-residencies-scholarships
    Sarabande Foundation · deadline 01 Aug 2026 · Heavily subsidised studio space (GBP 1 per sq ft per month including utilities), mentoring from industry experts, pro bono business support, and access to the Sarabande network. Free to apply.
  • Corridor: DAISY CHAIN Artist Commission (Adur, West Sussex)
    https://www.corridorprojects.org.uk/daisy-chain-commission
    Corridor Projects · deadline 03 Aug 2026 · GBP 4,200 artist fee (inclusive of VAT) paid in instalments, plus travel, and an additional budget for materials for creative production, workshops and exhibition outputs (e.g. print). No application fee.
